steps.body: {{codingConfigs}} setups: a model, the agent app and an effort. Hover one for cost, time and tokens.

steps.body: The collector adds up your agents' tokens, cost and time per model and day.

steps.body: Prompts, transcripts, file paths and keys stay on your machine.
